ces.intent: Infra fixture for dry-run CI testing — 6 steps covering Azure GCC High CMMC L2 enclave provisioning

milestones.name: Azure Enclave Provisioned
exit_criteria: Log Analytics Workspace active with 90-day retention
Key Vault deployed with soft-delete and purge protection
VNet and NSG configured with deny-all baseline
Sentinel onboarded with CMMC analytics rules
Diagnostic settings active on all resources

steps.title: Provision Azure Resource Group and Foundation Controls

control_coverage.gap_rationale: No Azure resource group or subscription context established

what_to_do: Set Azure subscription context for GCC High tenant
Create Azure resource group in usgovvirginia
Assign CMMC L2 built-in policy initiative to subscription
Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud P2 across all resource types

vendor_help_refs.title: Azure Policy built-in initiative for CMMC L2

expected_artifacts.description: Resource group configuration export with tags and policy assignment

manual_completion_criteria: Resource group exists in usgovvirginia
CMMC L2 policy initiative assigned at subscription scope
Defender for Cloud P2 enabled on all resource types

steps.title: Deploy Log Analytics Workspace and Immutable Log Storage

control_coverage.gap_rationale: No centralized logging workspace or immutable log storage exists

what_to_do: Create Log Analytics Workspace with 90-day retention in usgovvirginia
Create storage account with HTTPS-only, TLS 1.2 minimum, no public blob access
Configure immutability policy on logs container with 90-day lock

vendor_help_refs.title: Log Analytics Workspace in Azure Government

expected_artifacts.description: Log Analytics Workspace configuration with retention settings

manual_completion_criteria: Log Analytics Workspace active with 90-day retention
Storage account immutability policy locked for 90 days

steps.title: Deploy Key Vault with Encryption Key Management

control_coverage.gap_rationale: No customer-managed key infrastructure for CUI encryption at rest

what_to_do: Create Azure Key Vault with soft-delete and purge protection enabled
Enable RBAC authorization model on the vault
Assign Key Vault Crypto Officer role to the automation service principal

expected_artifacts.description: Key Vault configuration export with soft-delete and purge-protection status

manual_completion_criteria: Key Vault deployed with soft-delete enabled
Key Vault deployed with purge protection enabled
RBAC authorization model active

steps.title: Deploy Virtual Network, NSG, Firewall, and Bastion

control_coverage.gap_rationale: No network boundary controls or segmentation in place

what_to_do: Create VNet with /16 address space in usgovvirginia
Create management, workload, AzureBastionSubnet, and AzureFirewallSubnet subnets
Create NSG with deny-all inbound and deny-all outbound baseline rules
Allow inbound from AzureBastionSubnet on ports 22 and 3389
Associate NSG with workload subnet
Enable Network Watcher and NSG flow logs to storage account
Create Azure Firewall Premium with public IP
Create Azure Bastion Standard with public IP

expected_artifacts.description: Network Security Group rules export confirming deny-all baseline

manual_completion_criteria: VNet created with /16 address space
NSG deny-all baseline rules active on workload subnet
Azure Firewall Premium deployed
Azure Bastion Standard deployed
NSG flow logs enabled to storage account

steps.title: Onboard Microsoft Sentinel and Configure CMMC Analytics Rules

control_coverage.gap_rationale: No SIEM or security analytics platform configured for threat detection

what_to_do: Onboard Microsoft Sentinel to the Log Analytics Workspace
Enable Azure Activity, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Azure Key Vault data connectors
Create Scheduled analytics rules for: privileged identity changes, malware detection, excessive failed logins, unauthorized resource deletion

expected_artifacts.description: Sentinel analytics rules export confirming CMMC alert rules are active

manual_completion_criteria: Sentinel onboarded to Log Analytics Workspace
Three data connectors enabled (Activity, Defender, KeyVault)
Four CMMC analytics rules active and enabled

steps.title: Configure Diagnostic Settings for All Enclave Resources

control_coverage.gap_rationale: No diagnostic settings routing resource logs to centralized Log Analytics Workspace

what_to_do: Set diagnostic settings on resource group activity log to Log Analytics Workspace
Set diagnostic settings on Key Vault to Log Analytics Workspace
Set diagnostic settings on NSG to Log Analytics Workspace
Set diagnostic settings on Storage Account to Log Analytics Workspace
Set diagnostic settings on Virtual Machine to Log Analytics Workspace

expected_artifacts.description: Diagnostic settings configuration export confirming all resources log to LAW

manual_completion_criteria: Diagnostic settings active on resource group activity log
Diagnostic settings active on Key Vault
Diagnostic settings active on NSG
Diagnostic settings active on Storage Account
Diagnostic settings active on Virtual Machine

assessor_alignment_notes: All provisioning steps use Azure PowerShell Az module cmdlets against AzureUSGovernment environment
Evidence commands are machine-generated exports suitable for CMMC assessment
Dry-run CI mode validates command assembly without making Azure API calls
